geography_finding.conclusion: ABS state_electoral_division for TAS is an INTERSECTION of the two chambers (e.g. 'Bass (Launceston)') and matches NEITHER chamber 1:1. TAS House of Assembly divisions ARE coterminous with the Commonwealth electoral divisions, so the correct directory is commonwealth_electoral_division_2021 (ids 601-605).
geography_finding.sed_2011_vs_2016: byte-identical for TAS (25 rows, same ids and names)
geography_finding.sed_2021: differs: Denison->Clark, Apsley removed, Prosser added, ids shifted
geography_finding.legislative_council: 15 single-member divisions; NO directory exists that matches them 1:1 -> no FK, district_name only

licence.verdict: CC BY 4.0 — confirmed, covers the results files

licence.how_found: tec.tas.gov.au/copyright 404s. The link lives in /navigation/footer.html, a w3-include-html client-side include present on every page including the results pages, so it is invisible to a plain crawl of the rendered HTML.

source_shape.w3_include_trap: Result tables are injected client-side via w3-include-html; the payloads are sibling fragments fp-<div>-m.html and dist-<div>-m.html. A scrape of the rendered division page sees an empty shell and wrongly concludes the archived results were deleted.
source_shape.hoa_inline_era: 2018 and earlier carry result tables inline, not in fragments
source_shape.hoa_2014: PDF only (scrutiny event sheet + first prefs by polling place)
source_shape.denison_clark: TEC Divisions.html: 'Following amendments to the Constitution Act, which gained Royal Assent on 28 September 2018, House of Assembly electoral names and boundaries were updated to match changes to Federal divisions' and 'Prior to 2018, the Division of Clark was known as the Division of Denison'. Same page: 'These divisions have the same boundaries as the five Commonwealth House of Representatives divisions for Tasmania.'
source_shape.disclosure_register: Populated from 1 Jul 2025: static HTML fragments under disclosure-and-funding/registers-and-reports/ on the CC-BY host. The Power Apps portal renders 'There are no records to display' as a template placeholder — not evidence of emptiness.
